title: Displayed Poem

illustrates.quote: The adjusted left margin (2 cells to the right of the runover position) for displayed text in exercise material is based on the material to which it applies.

items.text: 41. Read the stanza from the poem.

lines.text: And there will I keep you forever,
Till the walls shall crumble to ruin,

items.text: What does the speaker want to show about his feelings for the children?
A. He wants the children to leave him alone.
B. He enjoys playing make-believe games with them.
C. He will cherish them eternally.
D. He wants them to stay young always.
